summary: Build ISO/IEC 27002 control knowledge with PECB Manager training. Explore ISMS topics, prepare for the exam, and understand credential requirements.
audienceIntro: This training is intended for professionals who contribute to information security management or control work. It assumes a foundation in ISO/IEC 27002 and comprehensive knowledge of information security, as stated on the PECB course page.
prerequisites: The PECB course page lists a fundamental understanding of ISO/IEC 27002 and comprehensive knowledge of information security as the main prerequisites.
